scope: A cache attribution, B native endpoint semantics, C first-window waypoint controllability

conditional_phases.2.22: D structured complete route pool after C passes
conditional_phases.2.23: E fixed-pool HSI selection after D passes

generation.seed_formula: 42 + canonical_ordinal; sample_calls reset0 for each arm
generation.repeat_rule: repeat Wplus once on each listed task if applicable, with the identical seed; require bitwise raw/edited and model-input equality
generation.controls: unchanged P15 online, Arm B500, B1 legacy editor, R2 loaded but zero HSI forwards; unchanged initial history/frame/text/object goal/progress/time
generation.W0_regression: regenerate first window once for all28; require bitwise raw_source/proposal/edited vs sealed C0 before interpreting response
generation.normal: nearest original path point to W0 world waypoint; outgoing nonzero segment, or incoming segment at endpoint; n=(-tz,tx)/norm(t)
generation.applicability: both signed variants required; original waypoint must precede last path point, navigation flags true, nonzero tangent; shifted query at initial world pelvis height must be in scene bounds and static occupancy0; retain individual reasons
generation.coordinate_rule: apply world XZ offset, preserve world waypointY, transform through the identical recorded mat; model goals0:3 copy local pelvis metres and forceY0; object goals6:9 keep existing normalization

cache_analysis.units: metres internally, mm reported; coordinate RMS not mean Euclidean distance
cache_analysis.comparisons: each of candidates1/2/3 vs C0 at matching window; first window primary, subsequent windows descriptive with divergent histories
oracles: minHS among all4 without quality protection
cache_analysis.oracle_ties: candidate index ascending; report complete native15 of one actual selected candidate; no deployment or feedback

endpoint.human: actual retained evaluated SMPL-X root; clone and setY0, distance to original pelvis_goal
endpoint.object: actual retained interpolated object translation; full3D distance to original object_goal
endpoint.complete: both errors strictly<0.10m; no epsilon in classification
endpoint.retained_frames: explicit actual emitted count after any truncation/termination; current evaluator keeps coarse0..13 in nonfinal windows,0..15 final, then interpolation scale3 with held tail; no early stop in current fixed-budget path
endpoint.cache_check: compute from motions/tasks, then compare112 sealed native endpoint numbers with tolerance1e-5cm and exact completed; no native reports used as selector inputs

control_metrics.frames: all future local2..15 equally; dt.1s, fixedW0 support/contact masks; no outcome-based frame choice
control_metrics.response: sign times mean world candidate-minusW0 root or object XZ displacement projected on registered normal; raw and edited separately
control_metrics.quality: fixedW0 active hand object-local anchor drift, min hand-to128-surface distance/fraction<.10m, fixedW0 support XZ speed, human/object nearest-free-voxel RMS and occupied fractions, world joint speed retention
control_metrics.source_scale: no dynamic source-error optimization or tuning
control_metrics.no_native_claim: first-window proxies are not full task completion, nativeFS or native meshHS/OS

gate.quality_rule: both signs/raw and edited: task95% upper for increases <=margin, lower for contact fraction>=-margin; mean joint speed ratio>=.95. New.1cm/.005 scene tolerances are one-shot first-window protection decisions, not native thresholds.
gate.useful_task_rule: both signs edited root>=.01m, object directed response>=0, all per-task quality margins and speed retention pass
gate.integrity: all28 W0 regressions, eligible pairing/input/finite/history/editor guards, exact repeats; technical failure BLOCKED
gate.visual: all28 root/object traces and first-window animations with applicability labels; fixed014/329/371/420 and worst contact/HS reviewed; if independent naturalness review unavailable mark pending and withhold expansion
gate.failure: low coverage inconclusive; response/quality failure NO-GO; no bigger offset/no seed search/no route pool/no HSI scoring

statistics.unit: paired applicable tasks; four-scene sensitivity, missing/inapplicable counts retained

execution.gpus: 4 RTX3090 scene lanes, CUDA7 analysis; record actual usage

closure: one subphase/session; engineering closure requires tested implementation and full positive/negative evidence. Subsequent2.22/2.23 require their own preregistered protocols and passed predecessors
